name: @typespec/compiler-rust
description: Learning-project Rust port scaffold for the TypeSpec compiler.

scripts.build: napi build --platform --release --esm --manifest-path ../../crates/typespec-napi/Cargo.toml --output-dir . && node patch-index-exports.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.build:debug: napi build --platform --esm --manifest-path ../../crates/typespec-napi/Cargo.toml --output-dir . && node patch-index-exports.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.build:spike: node -e "console.log('Spike crate is frozen on napi v2; see docs/rust-port/spike-napi-roundtrip.md')"
